notes.title: Tower! Simulator 3 - 40% OFF NOW
notes.content:
Hello Everyone, it's been a while 🙂 As we look back on our journey, we can't help but feel a swell of pride for the golden days of FeelThere, from 2002 to 2010ish, when we were at the forefront of developing aircraft for Microsoft's Flight Simulator. Since then, we've shifted our focus to our own air traffic control simulation product line, with Tower! Simulator 3 leading the charge nowadays. Yet, despite its rising popularity, it seems that many are still unaware of this gem in our arsenal. 

Let's set the record straight. Our passion lies in creating immersive experiences for the flight simulation community, especially airports. While these airports are also compatible with Microsoft Flight Simulator, Tower! - Air Traffic Control simulator is our heart and soul. 

We are now offering 40% discount until the 20th of May on  Tower! Simulator 3, as we are slowly phasing out and will discontinue the older version + DLC of Tower!3D & Pro. 


This change unfortunately must happen, as there are continuous developments with our voice recognition and so many new hardware out there, simply put, there is no way we can match this old versions compatibility to these new developments, and therefore can't guarantee a smooth and enjoyable experience with it. We believe that this discount will change your mind to switch over after our latest Update 3 that bring the voice recognition to a new level. 

Read our latest post about the update here!

notes.content:

 Detailed graphic design

[previewyoutube=cp5KrbrVMfE;full][/previewyoutube]

IATA: SIN, ICAO: WSSS

[Changi Airport is at the eastern end of Singapore close to Marina Bay downtown. As one of the world's busiest airports by international passenger and cargo traffic. It has been rated the World's Best Airport by Skytrax, highly rated international transit transports and it is one of the world's cleanest airports.

It is the home base of Singapore Airlines, Singapore Airlines Cargo, Jetstar Asia Airways, Scoot and BOC Aviation.

Changi served 68.3 million passengers in 2019, making it the 18th busiest airport in the world.
It has 3 asphalt runways and five main passenger terminals arranged in an elongated inverted 'U'shape with Jewel in the center of the 'U' shape.
